check: deterministic signed agent worker replay policy preflight
scope: Offline mocked agent task, safety, and worker checks; no database or provider access
behavior: The deterministic worker validates task capabilities and required inputs before replay lookup.
Read and draft-create safety policies are checked before an idempotent retry returns.
A mutated task registry that permits publication fails closed before receipt lookup or database access.
limitations: Does not authenticate the worker process or establish database least privilege.
Does not establish populated agent output parity or deployment acceptance.
